answer: Weighted Resource Fingerprint. Each identity must anchor a continuous sensor trace (thermal noise, power draw) from dedicated hardware during registration. The system compares this trace against a marble-pattern baseline of known shared-farm signatures and rejects matching profiles. A mirror check re-samples the trace weeks later, requiring the same physical device to reproduce it. Faking costs one dedicated device per identity plus ongoing idle runtime; sharing hardware collapses every trace into one rejectable signature.
